question: In what sequence must the element become progressively larger from that point onward?
premises: A starting point is indicated by that prior element.
The sequence extends to the end of the pigeon projection.
The element must become larger in that sequence.
inference: From that point onward, following the sequence to the end of the pigeon projection, it should become progressively larger.
plain_english: From there, in sequence up to the end of the pigeon projection, make it progressively larger.
